decisions.reason: Although technically close to our wafer-processing knowledge base, its disappearance from the website after 2019 suggests limited commercial traction or overlap with newer packaging-wafer developments, so we would reallocate resources.
This flagship Cu-interposer glass wafer fits our core materials and process capabilities and our in-house R&D and research cooperation give us strong ability to learn and improve it commercially.
The off-the-shelf glass and quartz wafer brand is very close to our established offer, uses existing know-how and production assets, and therefore has low withdrawal risk.

Glass-based circuit boards are comparatively distant from our established substrate business, so despite our R&D strength our absorptive capacity is weaker here and the product is less aligned with our stated strategic direction.
